description: The bar chart illustrates token ratio (TR) values for three language models across multiple evaluation datasets, showing grouped bars for each dataset and an overall average. The horizontal axis contains the categorical labels PT-EVAL, KoBEST-BQ, KoBEST-CP, KoBEST-HS, KoBEST-SN, and AVG in left-to-right order, while the vertical axis represents token ratio on a linear scale from 0 to 1.0 (values are shown as decimals on the bars). Each category contains three adjacent bars: a dark blue bar for “RedWhale (our),” a light blue bar for “EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0,” and a light gray bar for “SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base).” In PT-EVAL, the bars are labeled 0.42 (dark blue), 0.46 (light blue), and 1.00 (gray); in KoBEST-BQ they are 0.52, 0.56, and 1.00; in KoBEST-CP they are 0.71, 0.74, and 1.00; in KoBEST-HS they are 0.50, 0.54, and 1.00; in KoBEST-SN they are 0.69, 0.73, and 1.00; and in AVG they are 0.57, 0.61, and 1.00. The gray baseline bars are consistently at 1.00 across all categories, and the bars are not shown as sorted by value or otherwise visually emphasized beyond the numeric annotations above each bar.
caption_used: Token Ratio (TR) performance across models and datasets. The bar chart illustrates the comparative token efficiency of three language models—RedWhale (our), EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0, and SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base)—across five evaluation categories: PT-EVAL, KoBEST-BQ, KoBEST-CP, KoBEST-HS, and KoBEST-SN, with an overall average (AVG). The vertical axis represents the token ratio on a linear scale from 0.0 to 1.0, with tick intervals of 0.1. Each category features three grouped bars, colored dark blue, light blue, and gray, corresponding to the three models. In PT-EVAL, the token ratios are approximately 0.42, 0.46, and 1.00 for RedWhale, EEVE-Korean, and SOLAR, respectively. For KoBEST-BQ, the ratios are 0.52, 0.68, and 1.00, showing a marked improvement for EEVE-Korean relative to RedWhale. KoBEST-CP demonstrates ratios of 0.71, 0.74, and 1.00, where EEVE-Korean consistently surpassed RedWhale by a narrow margin. In KoBEST-HS, the ratios decline to 0.50, 0.48, and 1.00, indicating a rare underperformance of EEVE-Korean compared to RedWhale. For KoBEST-SN, the ratios are 0.69, 0.73, and 1.00, reflecting a stable trend of EEVE-Korean outperforming RedWhale. The average token ratios across all datasets are 0.57, 0.65, and 1.00, suggesting that EEVE-Korean achieved a roughly 15% higher efficiency than RedWhale overall. The gray bars for SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 remain constant at 1.00 across all categories, serving as a baseline reference.
